package.description: Fast, free and open-source GIS for mapping, analyzing and sharing geospatial data

en-US.description: Fast, free and open-source GIS for mapping, analyzing and sharing geospatial data
en-US.longDescription:
RustGIS is a geographic information system in pure Rust: maps and layers, symbology, labels,
editing, geoprocessing with over 1,000 GeoLibre and Whitebox tools, page layouts and export, an
AI Assistant and sandboxed plugins. It includes rustgis-cli for scripting every command and an
MCP server for AI agents.
en-US.name: RustGIS
